phase: after source inspection, before development regression and candidate execution
question: Does restricting candidate image opens to the promised PNG decoder prevent benign other-format decoder selection without changing valid PNG review behavior?
observations: Two caller-supplied candidate Image.open sites sniff arbitrary registered formats before a PNG-only format check.
Pillow13.0.0 is installed and matches requirements; supported Inkscape renderer available; CairoSVG unavailable.
premise: A normal JPEG is already intended to be rejected; the desired invariant is rejecting it before selecting its decoder.
candidate: formats=[PNG] on the two review opens, with UnidentifiedImageError normalized to existing ValueError malformed-candidate behavior. No visual scoring or permission changes.
prediction: An ordinary JPEG decoder-entry spy is entered on baseline but not candidate; valid PNG and existing source/hash/net-review gates remain unchanged.
falsifier: Candidate enters JPEG decoder or rejects valid PNG fixture or regresses any existing controlled-drafting gate.
bounds: Synthetic PNG/JPEG only, local temporary output, no malformed advisory samples, no network, no image model, no publication.
independent_controls: Fresh branched/pin/junction holdout remains unopened until code hash is frozen; evaluation agent owns those cases.

simplex.reason: Decoder selection is a discrete format contract, not a simplex calculation.
simplex.invariant: Only PNG parser admitted for candidate payloads.

n_ality.reason: Keep format admission, source identity and visual scientific correctness as separate axes.
n_ality.invariant: A parser regression pass does not imply correct wiring.

continuum.reason: No raster registration or geometry tolerance change in this patch.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Format admission and identity gates are Boolean.
fuzzy_logic.invariant: No confidence score can soften rejection.
